title: TME: Ethernet thermometer
desc: TME is a Thermometer with direct output to Ethernet (IP Thermometer), Measuring range is -55 C to +125 C. TME has an internal WEB server , which allows you to view Temperature directly in your WEB browser - no additional software is required.
